description: A deterministic pre-registered 30-case semantic retrieval extension authored before running any retriever against it. It contains 24 positive-quality queries and 6 policy-only queries across direct recall, multi-session entities, same-identity updates, English, Chinese, mixed-language paraphrases, lifecycle states, expiration, erasure, and adversarial scope isolation. Every positive case defines at least twelve active serviceable cards in the query scope, including at least five same-entity, same-relationship, same-category hard negatives with distinct keys and values. Opaque aliases are judgments only and never appear in searchable memory fields.
